_comment:
Component ablation for ISG on autext23-s2 (6-class). Each component is removed one at a time (OFAT). Runs with TransformerConv and Hybrid-ISG-GTN.

  Component mapping:
    ISG POS          -> add_pos_feat          (POS embeddings on nodes)
    Edge Attr        -> edge_attr              (dep embedding concat into K,V of attention)
    Token Distance   -> use_token_distance_attn (distance gating on attention scores — only Hybrid)
    Dep. sintáctica  -> use_edge_bias          (dep relation bias on attention scores — only Hybrid)

  NOTE: 'Sin POS' requires a separate PKL build (add_pos_feat=false changes node features).
  All other ablations reuse the same PKL.

experiments._comment3: Token Distance y Dep. Sint. no aplican a GNN estándar.
experiments._comment4: Edge Attr y Dep. Sint. son la misma palanca para TConv.
